Split illustration showing subsistence and commercial farming in Nigeria. On the left: A Nigerian farmer in simple clothing using a hoe on a small, mixed crop farm containing maize and yam mounds. On the right: A modern green tractor pulling a plough on a vast, neatly planted monocrop field.
